name: riderhub
description: RiderHub — motorcycle companion PWA. Root scripts for setup and running both apps.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.deploy:web: npm --prefix frontend run build && node tests/phase31.mjs . && node tests/phase36.mjs frontend/dist && firebase deploy --only hosting,functions,firestore:rules
scripts.deploy:preview: npm --prefix frontend run build && firebase hosting:channel:deploy preview --expires 7d
scripts.serve:web: npm --prefix frontend run build && firebase emulators:start --only hosting,firestore --project riderhub-test --config firebase.emutest.json
